description: Record a VERIFIED on-chain PVT burn your agent already broadcast (a Transfer to 0x0 on the PVT token) — the demand side of burn-to-present. Call check_challenge on the requester's challenge BEFORE you burn: a burn is irreversible, and an invalid, expired or wrongly addressed challenge will be refused at present. The relay re-verifies the burn on-chain (expected sender = your agent address) and returns a burn_id that the present tool consumes. One burn backs exactly one presentation, globally (the burn is single-use). Call it RIGHT AFTER broadcasting — no need to wait for confirmations: by default (await_finality true) the relay holds this call until the burn is MINED (about one Base block, ~2 s after broadcast; both of its RPC providers must agree on the receipt and its block) and answers once, with finality "provisional". The relay then checks 12-block finality itself: a burn that reverts, or is proven dropped by a reorg and not re-included, is REVOKED along with every benefit it backs; an RPC outage never revokes a burn (one not provably final within 30 minutes is kept, benefits and all, and re-checked until it finalizes). Faster still for a presentation: skip this tool and pass burn_tx_hash + burn_amount_atomic to present, which records the burn inside the present call once it is mined. Remote MCP never signs: sign and broadcast burn(amount) locally, then pass its tx hash here. Requires agent API credentials + your wallet_id.

amount_atomic.description: Burned amount in atomic 18-decimal PVT units, as a positive integer string.

await_finality.description: Default true: the relay holds the call until the burn is mined and accepted (~one Base block; the name is kept for compatibility — it no longer waits for 12-block finality) instead of refusing an early record. false: answer at once (refuses until the burn is mined).

chain.description: Chain the burn is on. PVT is Base-only; default 'base'.

tx_hash.description: The on-chain burn tx hash (0x + 64 hex).

name: record_burn
